holidays.name: National Fried Chicken Day
holidays.description: A crispy, golden celebration of one of America's favorite comfort foods. Folks across the country mark the day by hitting up drive-throughs, church-style buffets, or frying up a batch at home.
holidays.origin: Like many food holidays, it grew out of unofficial food-observance calendars and restaurant promotions rather than any act of Congress. It is widely observed in the United States on July 6.
holidays.funFact: Fried chicken is often traced to Scottish frying traditions combined with West African seasoning and cooking techniques, which blended in the American South.

holidays.name: International Kissing Day (World Kiss Day)
holidays.description: A day dedicated to puckering up. People celebrate with smooches for partners, kids, pets, and anyone brave enough to say yes.
holidays.origin: World Kiss Day is generally said to have started in the United Kingdom and spread through social media and greeting-card culture. It has no official government recognition.
holidays.funFact: The scientific study of kissing is called philematology, and researchers say a kiss can swap millions of bacteria between two people.

holidays.name: National Dog Treats Day (Unofficial Pet Observance)
holidays.description: A day for spoiling the good boys and girls with extra snacks. Owners treat their pups to biscuits, peanut butter goodies, or homemade bites.
holidays.origin: Pet-industry and social media calendars popularized the idea as an excuse to reward dogs with something tasty. It is informal and tied to no single founder.
holidays.funFact: Dogs have roughly 300 million scent receptors compared to about 6 million in humans, so a treat's smell can be a huge part of the thrill.

holidays.name: Fresh Spring Rolls Day
holidays.description: A celebration of translucent rice paper wraps stuffed with herbs, vegetables, noodles, and shrimp or tofu, served with peanut or hoisin dipping sauce. It's the perfect light summer snack.
holidays.origin: The day emerged from online food-holiday calendars highlighting Vietnamese-style summer rolls, known as gỏi cuốn. It has no official sponsor.
holidays.funFact: Unlike fried egg rolls, fresh spring rolls are not cooked after assembly, so the rice paper wrapper is just softened with water.

holidays.name: Frida Kahlo Day
holidays.description: An observance honoring the iconic Mexican painter famous for her vivid self-portraits, bold style, and unflinching art. Fans celebrate with flower crowns, art projects, and museum visits.
holidays.origin: Kahlo was born on July 6, 1907, in Coyoacán, Mexico City, and her birthday has become a day for art lovers to celebrate her legacy.
holidays.funFact: Kahlo often claimed she was born in 1910 to align herself with the Mexican Revolution, though her birth certificate shows 1907.
